title: Right of injunction.
bodyText: The department of commerce and consumer affairs, in addition to any other remedies available, may apply to a court having competent jurisdiction for an injunction to restrain any violation of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§452-25]  Right of injunction.  The department of commerce and consumer affairs, in addition to any other remedies available, may apply to a court having competent jurisdiction for an injunction to restrain any violation of this chapter. [L 1986, c 99, §2]
